stem: The diagrams show forces acting on a toy car as it moves to the right. Which diagram shows the toy car that will most likely accelerate to the right based on these conditions?
visual_elements: Diagram F shows forces 6 N to the left and 8 N to the right.
Diagram G shows forces 10 N to the left and 8 N to the right.
Diagram H shows forces 10 N to the left and 10 N to the right.
Diagram J shows forces 13 N to the left and 10 N to the right.
